app.name: OBD Diagnose
app.disclaimerShort: Diagnosis only — clearing codes does not fix the fault
app.loadingDatabase: Initializing local database & DTC fault codes…

connect.title: Connect to car
connect.subtitle: Pick the adapter port and start a diagnostic session.

scan.title: Scan
scan.subtitle: Read stored and pending faults plus readiness monitors.
scan.notConnectedBody: Open the Connect page, choose the COM port and start a session. The scan then reads stored, pending and permanent codes, readiness monitors, the VIN, freeze frames and live PIDs.

vehicles.title: Cars
vehicles.subtitle: Pick the car you are diagnosing. Cars and choices stay on this device.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Every scan session saved on this device.
history.emptyBody: Each scan is stored locally: car, date, codes and clear status — nothing is sent to the internet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, appearance and app information.
settings.safetyBody: This app is a diagnostic tool. Clearing codes does not fix the fault; it resets readiness monitors and the freeze frame.

vehicles.selectedNone: No car selected yet. Pick one below or add a new car.
vehicles.catalogHint: Choose make, then model, then year. The list is for selection only and does not verify the car.
vehicles.detectedTitle: Car detected via OBD diagnostic port
vehicles.makeUnknown: Make not in automatic database (select manually to remember for next time)
vehicles.freeHint: Enter the make and model as written on the car. They stay on this device.
vehicles.modelSearch: Search models in Arabic or English
vehicles.noResults: No match. Try the other language or use free text.
vehicles.notListed: My car is not in the list
vehicles.storageUnavailable: The local database is unavailable, so saved cars cannot be loaded or changed. Scanning still works.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load the saved cars.
errors.selectFailed: Could not remember the selected car.

connection.title: Adapter
connection.noPorts: No COM port found. Plug in the adapter, then refresh.
connection.plugInStep1: Plug the ELM327 adapter into the vehicle OBD-II port (usually under the dashboard).
connection.plugInStep2: Turn vehicle ignition switch to ON (engine off or running).
connection.plugInStep3: Select the COM port from the list and click 'Connect'.
connection.statusIdle: Not connected. Pick a port and press Connect.
connection.statusConnecting: Initialising the adapter and checking the engine ECU…
connection.ecuMissingBody: The adapter works but the engine ECU did not answer. Make sure the ignition is ON and the adapter is fully seated.
connection.cloneBody: Version {{version}} is common on cloned ELM327 adapters. Reading may work, but some commands or older protocols can fail.
connection.limitedBody: The adapter did not accept some initialisation commands; the app will rely on basic commands only.

scan.clearNoCodes: There are no stored or pending codes to clear.
scan.overallHealthyBody: No stored fault codes found and check-engine lamp is off.
scan.overallWarningTitle: Overall: Warning — Pending codes or warnings
scan.overallWarningBody: Pending codes or system warnings detected. Lamp may be off, but car needs follow up.
scan.overallFaultBody: Stored fault codes detected or Check Engine Light is illuminated.
scan.vinNotApplicable: Check digit not checked: position 9 is a letter, not a digit/X (many non-North-American VINs do not use the check digit).
scan.vinInvalid: Check digit mismatch: position 9 is a digit/X, so the ISO 3779 check applies.

warnings.pidsUnavailable: The ECU did not report its supported PIDs; only the codes and VIN were read.
warnings.pidNoData: PID {{pid}} is listed as supported but returned no data.
warnings.modeUnsupported: Mode {{mode}} is not supported by this ECU.
warnings.vinUnavailable: The ECU did not report a VIN.
warnings.vinInvalid: The VIN check digit does not match.
warnings.freezeFrameUnavailable: The ECU did not provide a freeze frame.
warnings.dtcCountMismatch: MIL status reported stored codes: {{reported}}; received: {{received}}.
warnings.headersUnavailable: The adapter did not enable response headers, so answers from different ECUs cannot be told apart.

scan.clearConfirmBody: The app saves a full backup in SQLite first, then sends the clear command (Mode 04). Notice: Clearing codes does NOT fix the physical fault, and resets readiness monitors and freeze frames.
scan.engineRunningWarning: The engine appears to be running (RPM above zero). Switching the engine off before clearing is safer. You can still continue.

clearOutcomes.codes_returned: codes_returned — the verification scan found codes again
clearOutcomes.no_codes_returned: no_codes_returned — the verification scan found no stored or pending codes
clearOutcomes.verification_failed: verification_failed — the ECU accepted the clear, but the verification scan failed

scan.clearOutcomeNote: A clean re-scan right after clearing does not prove the fault is repaired. Many codes return only after driving, so re-check after a few drive cycles.
scan.verificationFailed: The ECU accepted the clear, but the verification scan failed. Run a new scan when the connection recovers.
scan.dtcNoDescription: No description yet for this code. Check the vehicle's service manual.
scan.storageUnavailable: The local database is unavailable. You can still scan, but clearing codes, saved vehicles and code explanations are disabled.

errors.clearFailed: The clear flow could not finish. The codes may or may not have been cleared; run a new scan to check.
errors.busy: Another diagnostic operation is still running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.refused: The clear was refused. Nothing was backed up or cleared.
errors.backupFailed: The backup could not be saved, so nothing was cleared.
errors.malformed: The ECU sent an answer the app could not decode.
errors.storageUnavailable: The local database is unavailable, so the backup could not be saved and nothing was cleared.

errors.timeout: The adapter did not answer in time. Check the cable, make sure the ignition is ON, then retry.
errors.no-data: The adapter is connected but the engine ECU returned no data (NO DATA).
errors.unable-to-connect: Could not reach the car's protocol (UNABLE TO CONNECT). Check the adapter is fully seated and the ignition is ON.
errors.bus-init-error: Bus initialisation failed (BUS INIT ERROR). The adapter may not support this car's protocol.
errors.can-error: CAN bus error. Check the connection and retry.
errors.buffer-full: Adapter buffer overflow (BUFFER FULL). Reconnect and try again.
errors.unknown-command: The adapter rejected this command. It may be a clone or incompatible.
errors.adapter-error: The adapter reported an internal error (ERROR). Unplug and reconnect it.
errors.empty-response: The adapter returned an empty response.
errors.transport: Writing to the serial port failed.
errors.open-failed: Could not open the COM port. Another app may be using it.
errors.disconnected: The adapter disconnected. Reconnect it, then connect again.
errors.ports-unavailable: Could not read the COM port list.
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while connecting.

nrc.generalReject: The ECU rejected the request (general rejection).
nrc.serviceNotSupported: This service is not supported by the ECU.
nrc.subFunctionNotSupported: The ECU does not support this sub-function or data format.
nrc.incorrectLength: The request length or format is not accepted by the ECU.
nrc.busy: The ECU is busy. Wait a moment and retry.
nrc.conditionsNotCorrect: The ECU refused because the conditions are not correct (for example the engine state or ignition position).
nrc.requestOutOfRange: The request is outside the range supported by the ECU.
nrc.securityDenied: The ECU refused the request for security reasons.
nrc.responsePending: The ECU is still processing the request. Wait and retry.
nrc.serviceNotSupportedInSession: The service is not supported in the current session.
nrc.unknown: The ECU rejected the request with code {{nrc}}.
